2609.08216.title: Vision: Data-Centric Anchoring for Robust and Interpretable Agentic AI
2609.08216.paper_summary: Agentic AI systems built on large language models fail in two persistent ways that scaling does not fix: they break under distribution shift, and they cannot explain the decisions they make. We argue these are co-symptoms of one structural deficiency in the data lifecycle that governs how agents are trained, evaluated, and deployed. Observational interaction logs record what an agent did, not what it would have done otherwise. They encode spurious correlations without controlled variation, so they lack the counterfactual structure needed to separate causal signal from coincidence or to validate an explanation. No model-centric method can recover invariances the data never contained. We present Data-Centric Anchoring: robustness and interpretability should be engineered into the data environment, not extracted from models after training. Our central contribution is the Data-Centric Agentic Loop, a four-stage framework of Curate, Augment, Constrain, and Attribute. The ordering is structural, not stylistic. Curation precedes augmentation because generative models amplify whatever bias they are trained on. Augmentation precedes constraint because invariance objectives are vacuous without variation across environments to be invariant to. Attribution closes the loop, converting observed failures into targeted data interventions for the next iteration. Each stage manufactures the preconditions of the next, which makes the loop self-correcting rather than merely sequential. We ground the framework in a failure-driven taxonomy that links four core failure modes to the data lifecycle: spurious feature reliance, distribution-shift fragility, uncertainty miscalibration, and explanation unfaithfulness. We close with the limits of this approach and the open problems that stand between it and practical deployment at scale.
2609.08216.paper_summary_zh: 代理 AI 系統基於大型語言模型在兩個持續的方面失敗，這是擴展無法解決的：它們在分佈轉移下崩潰，並且無法解釋它們所做的決策。我們認為這些是數據生命周期中一種結構性缺陷的共同症狀，該生命周期決定了代理的訓練、評估和部署方式。觀察互動日誌記錄了代理所做的事情，而不是它本來會做的事情。它們編碼了虛假的相關性，沒有受控變化，因此缺乏分離因果信號與巧合或驗證解釋所需的反事實結構。沒有任何以模型為中心的方法可以恢復數據從未包含的恆常性。我們提出了以數據為中心的錨定：穩健性和可解釋性應該被設計進數據環境中，而不是在訓練後從模型中提取。我們的核心貢獻是以數據為中心的代理循環，這是一個四階段的框架，包括策展、增強、約束和歸因。這個順序是結構性的，而不是風格性的。策展在增強之前，因為生成模型會放大它們所訓練的任何偏見。增強在約束之前，因為恆常性目標在沒有環境變化的情況下是空洞的。歸因關閉了循環，將觀察到的失敗轉化為下一次迭代的有針對性的數據干預。每個階段都為下一個階段製造了前提條件，這使得循環是自我修正的，而不僅僅是順序的。我們將該框架建立在一個基於失敗的分類法上，將四種核心失敗模式與數據生命周期聯繫起來：虛假特徵依賴、分佈轉移脆弱性、不確定性錯誤校準和解釋不忠實。我們以這種方法的局限性和在其與實際大規模部署之間存在的開放問題結束。
